card.name: Words just before a country name
card.fires_on: Small words or gaps right before a country or nation name is expected, such as "of Scotland", "of Pakistan", or "New China". Seen mostly in web text about China or in nicknames like "Eiffel Tower of ...".

modes.label: China slogans
modes.description: Words inside Chinese political phrases or about Chinese culture, just before "China" or "Chinese".
modes.example: Without the Communist Party<< There>> Would Be No New China."

modes.label: Nicknames with of
modes.description: The word "of" or nearby words in "the X of Country" nicknames.
modes.example: Dubbed the ‘Picasso<< of>> Pakistan’, Sadequain’s art

card.writes: It pushes the model toward Chinese words such as 中国 and 伟大的, so a China-related continuation becomes more likely.
card.plain: It fires on small words that come just before a country name, especially China.
